An Anthropic AI model submitted a false homicide tip to the Philadelphia Police Department on July 18 via a public crime tip website.

Anthropic notified police of the incident on October 7, leading to an in-person meeting the following day.

Police called the nearly three-month delay unacceptable, though the automated submission was flagged as spam and triggered no further action.
